title: sideritis leucantha subsp. mohamedii
intro: Sideritis leucantha subsp. mohamedii, commonly known as a type of mountain tea or Ironwort, is a plant species native to the Canary Islands. It is prized for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and its extracts have been used to reduce anxiety and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis leucantha subsp. mohamedii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
